mapper.sql: id, purchase_no AS purchaseNo, title, requester_id AS requesterId, requester_name AS requesterName, buyer_id AS buyerId, buyer_name AS buyerName, project_id AS projectId, project_name AS projectName, funding_source AS fundingSource, supplier_name AS supplierName, platform_type AS platformType, platform_order_no AS platformOrderNo, currency, item_subtotal AS itemSubtotal, shipping_amount AS shippingAmount, discount_amount AS discountAmount, payable_amount AS payableAmount, actual_paid_amount AS actualPaidAmount, payment_difference_note AS paymentDifferenceNote, status, approval_required AS approvalRequired, approval_policy_version AS approvalPolicyVersion, approval_reasons_json AS approvalReasonsJson, ordered_at AS orderedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, close_reason AS closeReason, version, created_by AS createdBy, create_time AS createTime, updated_by AS updatedBy, update_time AS updateTime

o.id, o.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, o.title, o.requester_id AS requesterId, o.requester_name AS requesterName, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, o.buyer_name AS buyerName, o.project_id AS projectId, o.project_name AS projectName, o.funding_source AS fundingSource, o.supplier_name AS supplierName, o.platform_type AS platformType, o.platform_order_no AS platformOrderNo, o.currency, o.item_subtotal AS itemSubtotal, o.shipping_amount AS shippingAmount, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.payable_amount AS payableAmount, o.actual_paid_amount AS actualPaidAmount, o.payment_difference_note AS paymentDifferenceNote, o.status, o.approval_required AS approvalRequired, o.approval_policy_version AS approvalPolicyVersion, o.ordered_at AS orderedAt, o.completed_at AS completedAt, o.close_reason AS closeReason, o.version, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_procurement_order( purchase_no, title, requester_id, requester_name, project_id, project_name, funding_source, currency, item_subtotal, shipping_amount, discount_amount, payable_amount, status, version, created_by, create_time, updated_by, update_time ) VALUES( #{purchaseNo}, #{title}, #{requesterId}, #{requesterName}, #{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{fundingSource}, 'CNY', #{itemSubtotal}, #{shippingAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payableAmount}, 'DRAFT', 1, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_procurement_order SET title=#{title}, project_id=#{projectId}, project_name=#{projectName}, funding_source=#{fundingSource}, item_subtotal=#{itemSubtotal}, shipping_amount=#{shippingAmount}, discount_amount=#{discountAmount}, payable_amount=#{payableAmount}, version=version+1, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_procurement_order_line( order_id, line_no, component_id, component_name, manufacturer_name, mpn, component_spec_snapshot_id, spec_version, unit, ordered_quantity, unit_price, line_subtotal, received_quantity, canceled_quantity, version ) VALUES( #{orderId}, #{lineNo}, #{component.id}, #{component.name}, #{component.manufacturerName}, #{component.mpn}, #{component.currentSpecSnapshotId}, #{component.specVersion}, #{component.baseUnit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{lineSubtotal}, 0.000, 0.000, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab_procurement_order o WHERE o.id=#{id}

SELECT id, line_no AS lineNo, component_id AS componentId, component_name AS componentName, manufacturer_name AS manufacturerName, mpn, component_spec_snapshot_id AS componentSpecSnapshotId, spec_version AS specVersion, unit, ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, line_subtotal AS lineSubtotal, allocated_net_amount AS allocatedNetAmount, effective_unit_cost AS effectiveUnitCost, received_quantity AS receivedQuantity, canceled_quantity AS canceledQuantity, (ordered_quantity-received_quantity-canceled_quantity) AS remainingQuantity, version FROM lab_procurement_order_line WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY line_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, m.name AS manufacturerName, c.mpn, c.base_unit AS baseUnit, c.status, c.current_spec_snapshot_id AS currentSpecSnapshotId, c.spec_version AS specVersion FROM lab_component c INNER JOIN lab_component_manufacturer m ON m.id=c.manufacturer_id WHERE c.id=#{id}

sql.if: AND (o.purchase_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_procurement_order o WHERE 1=1
SELECT FROM lab_procurement_order o WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortOrder}, o.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
